conventions.ground: feet on y=0, origin at feet centre
conventions.silhouette: one connected component at 96 px and 48 px (3/4 ortho view), fill 0.25-0.75
conventions.contrast: body vs biome ground and hero accent vs body: luminance ratio >= 1.4 and (hue distance >= 25 deg or lightness diff >= 0.18)
conventions.hero: exactly one of hat / scarf / crest / backpack / bow / cap, at most one body pattern
conventions.materials: flat Principled BSDF colours (baseColorFactor), roughness 0.6, no textures; primitives per GLB: body, secondary, accent, dark, white
conventions.determinism: features + colours from random.Random('archetype|biome|seed'), personality from random.Random('archetype|biome|seed|personality')
